verdict.rationale: Authy documents automatic multi-device sync across phone and tablet ('Sync 2FA across mobile and tablet', 'On any device'), and users confirm they chose it for multi-device support. The computer leg is contradicted: docs list desktop platforms, but multiple users report the desktop apps were EOL'd, leaving only an iPad-app stop-gap on Apple silicon Macs. Missing for 10: supported desktop/computer sync, detail on how sync works (conflict handling, latency), independent hands-on confirmation of automatic sync reliability.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically

citations.quote: On any device. Your phone, tablet, even your Apple Watch.
I started using Authy long ago because it supports multiple devices
It's available for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
